title: Look — switching between your website's designs
body:
Several **designs** may have been made for your website: with the same texts and images, but a different layout,
fonts and colours. You saw them at the link you received from us („Design 1”, „Design 2”). In the **Look**
menu item (the first line of the „My site” group) you can switch to another design at any time, and back again the same way.
It works during the trial and after ordering, and the switch itself costs nothing.

![Screenshot: the Look page with two designs, on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

The previews in the image are simplified samples; in reality the card shows the design's full page.

If your site isn't ready yet, the page says: **„You can choose the look once your website is ready.”**

## Where to find it

- On a computer, in the left-hand menu, on the **Look** line. If several designs were made, next to it you can see which one
  is running now (for example „Design 1”).
- On a phone, the **„Menu”** button at the bottom of the page opens the full menu, where you'll find **Look**.
- If several designs were made, the **„Other design”** button on the opening-image card of the **Overview** takes you here too.

If only one design was made for your site, the page says so, and there's nothing to switch to.

## Viewing the designs

1. Each design is a card with a small preview. The preview already shows the design with your current texts and images —
   you see what you would get after switching.
2. The design running now carries the **„Shown now”** mark, and its button reads **„In use”**.
3. With the **„Desktop view”** and **„Phone view”** buttons you choose whether to view the designs
   as on a computer or as on a phone.
4. The **„View larger”** button (on a phone **„Larger”**, Larger) opens the full page, which you can scroll through.
   Here too you can choose between the views („Desktop” or „Phone”), and you can switch from here with the **„Choose this”**
   button at the bottom of the page. The arrow at the top left takes you back.

## Switching to another design

1. On the card of the design you want, tap **„Choose this”**.
2. A window asks whether you're sure you want to switch. You see the current and the new design side by side.
   - During the trial it says: the trial site appears with the new design straight away, and the trial period doesn't change.
   - If your site is already live, it warns: **„Your site is live: guests will see the new design straight away.”**
3. Tap „Switch to Design …”. It takes a few seconds while your site is rebuilt.
   If you change your mind, **„Cancel”** leaves everything as it was.

![Screenshot: the confirmation window before switching](assets/hu/megerosites.png)

Afterwards a green bar shows it's done. Here **„View the site”** opens your website in a new tab,
and „Undo (Design …)” switches you back to the previous design with one tap.

If for some reason your site couldn't be built with the new design, a red bar shows it, and nothing changes:
**„We couldn't build your site with the new design just now, so the old look has stayed. Please try again in a few minutes.”**

## What stays and what changes

At the bottom of the page two boxes sum it up, **„Kept when you switch”** and **„What changes”**:

- **Everything you changed stays**: the rewritten texts (name, tagline, introduction, highlights),
  your uploaded images and their order, the opening image, contact details and the map, the modules and their settings
  (prices, bookings, messages), and the web address and the trial or subscription.
- **What changes** is the layout, the fonts and colours, and the order and shape of the sections.
- **Where you haven't rewritten anything**, the other design's own text appears. The two designs' texts are mostly the same, but in places
  they may differ slightly. If you want to see a sentence as your own, rewrite it under **Texts**: from then on
  your text appears in every design.

## Good to know

- After switching, your order also takes the running design: if you order at the end of the trial, you get the design
  that is shown at that time.
- If your website is available in several languages (Multilingual website) and the switch also changes the text, the
  translated versions keep showing the earlier state until you regenerate them on the Modules page in the Multilingual website
  section — as after any text change, this costs the generation fee again.
  Your site in its own language updates immediately and free of charge.
- A design marked **„Not selectable”** is one we can't offer (for example because we found a mistake in it
  during review). Choose from the others — they remain available as before.
